usedFor: Process Street runs your checklists and TRIGGERcmd runs commands on your computers, so “Task Ready” can run “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “Task Ready” in Process Street, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: When a checklist task is ready, the command it needs starts on your computer.

watchOut: “Trigger Command” acts on your own computers, so test the chosen command before any task can start it.
